integrity: Analytical statements reconstructed from the exact reduced generator and checked by a separately implemented exact-rational program; finite tests are not universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to a resonant, initially doubly excited two-spin chain with positive independent local amplitude damping; no pumping, common bath, detuning, or extra spins.
The optimized quantity is the coefficient of variation of continuous first ground-state passage, not survival at each fixed time or binned hazard-estimator variance.
The exact moments follow by integrating a known analytical survival law; independent review of priority for the derived universal optimizer and frontier remains needed.
title: A universal fluctuation-minimizing exchange rate for two-site quantum failure
